test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A train crosses a man on a platform in 10 s and crosses the platform of 260 m in length in 20 s. What is the length of the train?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by man to cross the train = 10 s

Length of the platform = 260m 

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time 

**Calcualtion:**

Here, Time taken by train to cross the man = 10 s 

⇒ Distance = Speed × Time 

⇒ Distance = 10 S , Where S = Speed of the train ..............( 1)

⇒ Now, length of the platform = 260m 

Distance of the train + Length of the platform = Speed of the train × 20 ..........( put the value of Distance from equation (1) ) 

⇒ 10S + 260 = 20S

⇒ 260 = 10S

⇒ Speed of the train = 26 m/s

Now, Distance of the train = 10S = 10 × 26 = 260m.

**Hence, Length of the train is 260m.**
